review: P14 — Pierre Ultimate Vision Coverage & Commercial Truth — independent adversarial review
method: 3 independent Opus attackers (read-only), each told to REFUTE with file:line evidence. Groups: A inflation/verified-honesty/tests, B legal/payroll/sensitive/ROI, C perimeter/production/claim-safety.
verdict_on_review: The load-bearing doctrine HOLDS: no roadmap item counted VERIFIED (final tree), all external/legal/provider blockers surfaced & un-VERIFIABLE, sensitive-decision automation hard-floored to MUST_NOT_CLAIM (immovable, checked before any override), payroll/full-HR-replacement/country-guarantee forbidden, ROI cautious, pricing consistent with P10, catalog 50 groups/58 reqs/0 dup/every req a status, P8-P13 + Pierre V1 untouched, production OFF. 1 REFUTED + 6 PARTIAL were real quality issues — all FIXED.

refutedClaims.gap: The linter AFFIRMATIVELY APPROVED (allowed_caution) several reworded forbidden claims: 'assure la conformité juridique…', 'tranche seul les licenciements', 'calcule la paie…', 'garantit votre conformité RGPD…', 'remplace vos ressources humaines…', 'gère la paie / bulletins de salaire', 'remplace votre DRH/équipe RH'. Root cause: (1) FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS were synonym-fragile (assure vs garantit; tranche vs décide; RGPD/fiscale not covered; ressources humaines/équipe RH/DRH not covered; gère la paie not covered); (2) the operational-keyword heuristic ran after the forbidden loop and upgraded any risky-but-unmatched claim to allowed_caution.
refutedClaims.resolution: FIXED. (1) Broadened FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS to cover synonyms (assure/assurer/garantir + conformité of ANY kind; décide/tranche/statue/arbitre/prononce seul; licenci/sanction/renvoi/rétrograd seul-or-auto; remplace + ressources humaines/équipe|fonction|service|direction RH/DRH; gère/calcule/traite/génère la paie|bulletins|DSN). (2) Added a SENSITIVE_SIGNALS guard that runs BEFORE the operational heuristic: any claim containing a sensitive signal (remplace/seul/paie/conformité/DRH/licenci/…) that escaped the forbidden patterns returns unknown_review (human review mandatory), NEVER allowed_*. New tests assert the 9 reworded forms are never allowed_* (forbidden/unknown_review); a benign operational claim still returns allowed_caution (no over-blocking). Proof safety_spot_checks updated.

contracts.preparation is VERIFIED via the P9.6 browser mission ('Prépare le contrat CDI…'), which is a genuine contract-PREP demo; its legal validity is a separate LEGAL_BLOCKED requirement.

Coverage VERIFIED flags are the author's grounded assessment of P8-P13 evidence (each cites provenBy); the evaluator computes the deterministic rule over those flags.
